# CSC on PERTURB and R_COMP: result tables (auto-generated by src/csc_tables.py)

Orientation everywhere: higher score = more likely ERROR; flag at c > 0.5 (pre-registered). e = share of MUTANTS endorsed (c <= 0.5); recall = 1 - e; FA = share of CORRECT rows flagged. CIs: base-clustered bootstrap (B = 2000, seed 0) for PERTURB, sentence-clustered for typing, template-stratified sentence bootstrap for SIG AUROC.

## T0. Status: the pre-registered CSC peers could not be generated

# source: results/prereg_csc_P.json (deviation_D_BUDGET), results/api_cost_ledger.jsonl

Before the pilot, every OpenRouter call returned HTTP 403 aii_run_budget_exhausted (the run-wide 'Test idea' phase budget of $7.00 was spent by other artifacts: $7.03 at 07:26 UTC; the proxy says it does not reset while the run goes on). ':free' models were also exhausted (429 free-models-per-day-high-balance, 1000/day, reset ~16.7 h later). This artifact spent $0.0000088 (one 1-token probe). Hence NO CSC peer (mutant-signature, base-signature or FREE) could be generated.

API calls attempted by this artifact: 2 ledger records, total $0.0000088. Statuses: ['http_403', 'ok'].

Consequence: gates G3-P, G4 and MT(E) are UNTESTED. Zero-cost arms reported instead (labelled in every table): SIGPROXY (exp-7 SIG outputs of the same four families, R_COMP), LOCAL2 (secondary small local peers, same CSC prompt), FREE3 / exp-8 free consensus baselines, ORACLE_samevocab typing.

## T1. KEY STRUCTURAL FACT: which PERTURB rows keep their base's signature

# source: results/sig_sharing.csv (computed from the parsed formulas, not assumed)

Signature-preserving (100% share the base signature, so CSC peers for them ARE the base's peers): ADD_INTERNAL, BASE, CONN, CONTRAPOSITIVE, DEMORGAN, MOVE, NEG, QUANT, REORDER_COMMUTE, REORDER_QUANT, RESTR, REV, SWAP. Partly new: BIND, DROP. Always new (need their own peers): ADD_FOREIGN, MEANING_RENAME, RENAME_NONCE, RENAME_SYN. Consequence: for every signature-preserving mutant, CSC peers cannot have seen the error through the cue; a peer that endorses the (CORRECT) base cannot also endorse the mutant (they are z3 non-equivalent), so recall on these operators is bounded below by base endorsement. Anchoring can only act through NEW symbols (ADD_FOREIGN, MEANING_RENAME, RENAME_*, most BIND/DROP).
